name: formal-verification
description: Formal verification of code: TLA+ models drawn as Mermaid statecharts, and skills that create and maintain a project's formal checks.

interface.shortDescription: TLA+ statecharts and project-local formal checks
interface.longDescription: Formal verification where tests reach the least: statechart checks a TLA+ model with TLC and draws it as a Mermaid statechart with the shortest path to each broken rule; create-formal-verification-skill generates a project-local skill that verifies one property with the tool that fits; maintain-formal-verification-skill brings that verification back in line with the code after it changes.
defaultPrompt: Check this TLA+ model and draw it as a statechart.
Create a formal verification skill for this state machine.
